title: Finite affine ind-etale Cech exactness for comparison pullbacks of injectives
statement: Let Y be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], J an injective abelian sheaf on Y_et [def-sp-injective-resolutions, def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and F = nu_Y^{-1}J for the comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let V be an affine ind-etale Y-object [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. For a finite pro-etale covering U_i -> V whose nonempty repeated intersections are affine ind-etale Y-objects, the ordered Cech complex of F [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] is exact at every degree q+1, for q a natural number. Intersections include the one-factor terms, so the members themselves belong to the basis up to isomorphism. The empty covering is allowed.

source.place: Tag 099U, lemma-affine-vanishing, verification of condition (3); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/099U

proof.text: Rewrite positive-degree exactness of the ordered Cech complex as the assertion that every cocycle is a coboundary. For a degree q+1 cocycle c, apply exists_etale_cech_cocycle_lift. This gives a finite covering T_i -> W in the original Y_et site, a morphism phi from its categorical Cech complex C with coefficients J to the original ordered complex, and a cocycle c_prime in C with phi(c_prime)=c. This uses the existing geometric descent theorem for arbitrary coefficients, without any injectivity assumption, and includes empty covers.

Apply injective_sheaf_cech_acyclic to J on the fixed site Y_et and the covering T_i -> W, indexed by ULift(Fin n). Its degree q+1 homology is zero because q+1>0. The Mathlib equivalence exactAt_iff_isZero_homology and ab_exact_iff give a degree q cochain b with d(b)=c_prime. No injectivity on W_et or on the pro-etale site is used.

The degree q image phi(b) is a primitive of c: the complex-map equation gives d(phi(b))=phi(d(b))=phi(c_prime)=c. Apply exactAt_cechComplex_iff in the reverse direction. The argument uses the same descent theorem and exactness equivalence for empty indexing families and empty schemes, so no nonemptiness hypothesis is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 099U, condition (3): use the already proved finite affine cocycle descent theorem, injective etale Cech acyclicity, and the complex-map equation to transport a primitive.
